title: Islamic and Arabic Mathematical Texts: Original LaTeX and English Translation Drafts
description:
Public corpus page for Islamic and Arabic mathematical texts in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record exposes reader PDFs directly and keeps source material in a filtered ZIP artifact.

Status at a glance. Substantial working surface: 17 reader/index PDFs present; Partial working surface: working drafts for checking and continuation; No final certification: not a proofed critical edition.

Provenance. This page is derived from the current consolidated non-European mathematics release. The source ZIP contains filtered TeX/source artifacts for this corpus; the complete as-received raw provenance archive is preserved on the consolidated record. The workflow collects source scans and reference texts, converts them into TeX drafts, checks them into readable PDFs, and publishes source artifacts for inspection and correction.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Corpus-level public page with reader PDFs first and filtered TeX/source artifacts later.
